# Valeem

> Valeem provides one-to-one live online tuition for Cambridge O Level, IGCSE and A Level
> students, taught by trained subject teachers. Valeem has taught live online since 2019,
> has a network of 650+ trained educators, and serves students in 14+ countries.
> Its largest community of families is in the Gulf (Saudi Arabia, the UAE and neighbouring
> countries), alongside Pakistan.

## Programmes
- O Level and IGCSE tuition: one-to-one live online classes, syllabus coverage and past-paper practice.
- A Level tuition: one-to-one live online classes with subject specialists.
- Valeem Homeschool Pathways: a structured online academic programme for homeschooled children,
  with three stages (Explorers ages 7-9, Innovators ages 10-12, Scholars ages 13-14) and
  guidance towards O Level, IGCSE and A Level. Valeem is not a Cambridge school or examination centre.

## How it works
1. A parent or student tells Valeem the level, subject and goals.
2. A Valeem counsellor matches a suitable teacher.
3. The student takes a free demo class.
4. Classes start on an agreed timetable, scheduled for the family's time zone.

## Where we teach
Online, worldwide. Main regions: Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman and Pakistan.
